categories.evidence: NEW AIDE ⟦NAME_1⟧ HAS BEEN USING MOTHERS DEBIT CARD ⟦CARD_1⟧ AT ATMS
categories.why: An 88-year-old account holder with dementia appears to be financially exploited by a caregiver.
The family reports unauthorized ATM withdrawals on the debit card, which may trigger electronic-transfer error investigation requirements.
The account holder's SSN was supplied by and discussed with a third party (the daughter) whose authorization on the account is not documented.
